# Franka Panda modified DH kinematics. The final 0.20 m offset is calibrated
# against the observed starting TCP pose, and includes the gripper TCP.
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
ALPHA = np.array([0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2])
A = np.array([0,0,0,0.0825,-0.0825,0,0.088])
D = np.array([0.333,0,0.316,0,0.384,0,0.20])
QLIM = np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['panda_joint_limits_rad'])

def fk(q):
    T=np.eye(4)
    T[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('z',90,degrees=True).as_matrix()
    T[:3,3]=[0,-0.4,0.78]
    for qi,alpha,a,d in zip(q,ALPHA,A,D):
        R=Rotation.from_rotvec([alpha,0,0]).as_matrix()
        X=np.eye(4);X[:3,:3]=R;X[0,3]=a
        Z=np.eye(4);Z[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_rotvec([0,0,qi]).as_matrix();Z[2,3]=d
        T=T@X@Z
    return T

def ik(pos,qseed,rotation=None,orientation_weight=0.25):
    qseed=np.asarray(qseed,dtype=float)
    if rotation is None: rotation=fk(qseed)[:3,:3]
    def err(q):
        T=fk(q)
        poserr=T[:3,3]-pos
        orerr=Rotation.from_matrix(rotation@T[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec()
        return np.r_[poserr,orientation_weight*orerr,0.018*(q-qseed)]
    fit=least_squares(err,qseed,bounds=(QLIM[:,0]+1e-4,QLIM[:,1]-1e-4),max_nfev=250)
    return fit.x,np.linalg.norm(fit.fun[:3]),np.linalg.norm(fit.fun[3:6])/orientation_weight

def move_tcp(pos,qstart,fingers,rotation=None,n=20,note=''):
    q,pe,oe=ik(np.asarray(pos),qstart,rotation)
    print('IK',note, np.round(q,3), pe,oe,flush=True)
    rows=np.column_stack([np.linspace(qstart,q,n),np.full((n,2),fingers)])
    res=move_joint(rows,note=note)
    return res,q
